notes: QuorumToken (src/QuorumToken.sol) is a plain fixed-supply ERC-20: name Quorum, symbol QRM, 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the whole supply of 1,000,000,000 QRM (1000000000000000000000000000 minor units) once to msg.sender, the launch factory. There is no owner, no mint, no burn, no pause, no blacklist and no transfer fee or tax, so the supply can never grow and no privileged call can move or freeze a holder's balance. Transfers are exact, so the swarm's share, the pool seed, distributor claims and trades through the PoolManager all move precisely what they say. A type(uint256).max allowance is treated as infinite and not decremented; transfers to the zero address and approvals of the zero address revert. The token makes no external calls and contains no DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE or SELFDESTRUCT. No application contracts are part of this launch. The pool pairs with IMD (0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7) at the launch policy's 1.25% fee with tick spacing 60; pool.initialPrice is provenance only, the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply.
